decisions.decision: GitHub exact commit is source authority; D:\MAX_REBUILD exact-SHA checkout is runtime/E2E authority.
decisions.rationale: Separate source lineage from real Windows/MT5/browser evidence.
decisions.title: GitHub source / Owner-PC runtime separation

decisions.decision: Do not use GitHub Actions; acceptance executes on Owner PC against exact candidate SHA.
decisions.rationale: Owner runtime is the accepted runtime environment.
decisions.title: No GitHub Actions acceptance

decisions.decision: Owner explicitly selects qualified Strategy candidates, promotes Champion, and opens Research gates where required.
decisions.rationale: Automation operates inside an authorized gate, not between gates.
decisions.title: Owner controls advancement

decisions.decision: Strategy lifecycle provides parent authority to Research; Research does not retroactively redefine Strategy lifecycle state.
decisions.rationale: Preserve independent lineage and promotion/scientific authority.
decisions.title: Strategy and Research are separate authority domains

decisions.decision: Scientist may analyze authorized evidence and propose hypotheses but cannot declare hard PASS, select for Owner, open gates, change risk, mutate datasets or promote Champion.
decisions.rationale: Deterministic backend and Owner remain authorities.
decisions.title: Scientist is advisory only

decisions.decision: Replacing Champion A closes A tenure as FORMER while A source Challenger remains historical PROMOTED.
decisions.rationale: Champion tenure history and active Challenger eligibility are distinct.
decisions.title: Former Champion does not auto-reactivate

decisions.decision: Registry lineage OR COMMITTED Challenger batch permanently excludes a retained optimizer source tuple while durable authority remains.
decisions.title: Consumed Optimizer source remains consumed

decisions.decision: Research sample config remains Owner-editable; each execution snapshots the exact value into immutable authority.
decisions.rationale: Historical R00 4 trades/month is evidence, not a permanent current default.
decisions.title: Current Research config versus immutable execution snapshot

decisions.decision: Locked OOS/Fresh outcome evidence remains protected and non-adaptive under its protected authority.
decisions.title: Protected data cannot become tuning feedback

decisions.decision: R02 remains blocked until R01 scientific execution is separately authorized, executed, accepted and later Owner advancement is authorized.
decisions.rationale: Readiness cannot substitute for scientific acceptance.
decisions.title: R01 before R02
